text:
Maya: FYI — ACME (acct: ACME-894) opened a ticket: says they were charged twice for annual renewal. Customer sent two charge receipts. Very upset, wants refund ASAP.

Ajay: Confirming — sales created a manual invoice because they required a PO (inv: INV-2026-0042), then our recurring job also processed the subscription renewal (inv: SUB-2026-0019). Looks like both were paid.

Maya: Customer attached two charge ids: ch_1N7aZQx9y and ch_1N7aZQx9z. Both for $9,600.00 on 2026-03-17.

Sam: Thanks — can we get payment processor ids and permission to refund the duplicate? Which one should we refund: the manual invoice or the subscription charge?

Ajay: Manual invoice was created to honor PO, so that one should stand. The subscription auto-charge is the duplicate. Suggest refunding ch_1N7aZQx9z (the later timestamp).

Maya: Customer approved refund on whichever charge we pick, wants confirmation email and ETA for funds back.

Sam: I'll issue a full card refund from Stripe and generate a credit memo against the subscription invoice. Steps I'm going to run now:

```
# internal refund steps (billing runbook)
1) locate charge in Stripe: ch_1N7aZQx9z
2) create refund: POST /v1/refunds {"charge":"ch_1N7aZQx9z","reason":"duplicate"}
3) create credit memo tied to SUB-2026-0019 in our ledger
4) mark INV-2026-0042 (manual) as paid/kept
5) update subscription metadata: "blocked_auto_renew": true for this account to avoid recurrence
```

Ian: Quick ask — can you paste the webhook log for the subscription renewal? want to confirm why it triggered despite a manual invoice existing. Could be a timing race with the PO flow.

Sam: Pasting condensed webhook: 
```
{ "event": "invoice.payment_succeeded", "id": "evt_3Lk...", "invoice": "SUB-2026-0019", "charge": "ch_1N7aZQx9z" }
```
Looks like it succeeded at 2026-03-17T15:08Z. Manual invoice was marked paid at 2026-03-17T15:05Z — race condition.

Ian: OK — filing ENG-BUG-2987 to add a check: if a manual invoice is created within X minutes of a renewal event, skip auto-charge. Will prioritize.

Sam: Refund initiated in Stripe — refund id re_1LxF... — status: succeeded (pending settlement). Wasteful note: card reversal typically posts to customer in 3–7 business days depending on bank.

BillingBot: Refund processed: re_1LxF... linked to ch_1N7aZQx9z — amount refunded $9,600.00 — ledger entry CE-2026-115 created.

Maya: Sent customer an update: "We've refunded the duplicate charge (refund id re_1LxF...). You should see the funds back on your card in 3–7 business days. We've kept your manual PO invoice as the active charge and blocked further auto-renewals while we audit. Apologies for the disruption."

Zara: Please add a short email template for CS so we keep language consistent. Also create FIN ticket to reconcile the credit memo against our AR.

Sam: Adding FIN ticket FIN-4723 for reconciliation, linking CE-2026-115 and INV-2026-0042.

Zara: Customer replied: "Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please confirm once settlement completes."

Maya: Will follow up when refund posts. Closing action items: Sam — confirm ledger/credit memo, Ian — deploy guard for race condition, Ajay — verify sales flow & PO handling doc.

Sam: Done on ledger draft, will attach screenshot to FIN-4723.

Ian: Small patch deployed to staging to gate duplicate charge path. Patch id: pr-5123. Will schedule quick prod rollout after 1h smoke test.

Maya: Customer asked for confirmation email copy; here's what I sent (for records):

```
Subject: Refund issued for duplicate renewal — ACME account
Hi Sarah,

We issued a full refund for the duplicate renewal charge (refund id re_1LxF...). The manual invoice tied to your PO (INV-2026-0042) remains active and paid. You should see the refunded amount on your card in 3–7 business days.

We're sorry for the inconvenience — we've also implemented a temporary hold on auto-renewals for your account while we audit what happened.

If you need a faster reversal (bank-side), let us know and we'll escalate with Finance.

Best,
Maya — Redwood Support
```

BillingBot: Settlement update queued — will post when bank confirms (typically 3–7 days).

Maya: Marking this thread resolved for now. Will reopen if the customer reports not seeing funds within 7 business days. :white_check_mark:
